component.name: OpenXLR
component.summary: Control your XLR interface and mix audio with PipeWire

description.p: OpenXLR controls Elgato XLR interfaces and mixes microphone and application audio with PipeWire. Independent monitor and streaming mixes, plugin chains and profiles help manage your audio setup.
This experimental Flatpak needs a host udev rule for USB controls. The Wave XLR Pro UCM profile remains a manual setup step. Distro packages include more complete system integration.
